import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        redirect(args);
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int N = sc.nextInt();
        int M = sc.nextInt();
        int K = sc.nextInt();
        int C = sc.nextInt();
        int D = sc.nextInt();

        int[] a = new int[K];
        int[] starts = new int[N];

        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            a[i] = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            starts[a[i]]++;
        }

        int maxT = K + N + 1;
        int V = (maxT + 1) * N + 2;
        int src = V - 2;
        int sink = V - 1;
        MCMFGraph g = new MCMFGraph(V);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            if (starts[i] > 0) {
                g.add(src, i, 0, starts[i], 0);
            }
        }
        for (int t = 0; t <= maxT; t++) {
            g.add(t * N, sink, 0, K, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < maxT; t++) {
                g.add(t * N + i, (t + 1) * N + i, C, K, 0);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
            int u = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int v = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            for (int t = 0; t < maxT; t++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                    g.add(t * N + u, (t + 1) * N + v, C + (2 * j + 1) * D, 1, 0);
                    g.add(t * N + v, (t + 1) * N + u, C + (2 * j + 1) * D, 1, 0);
                }
            }
        }

        Pair<Integer, Integer> fc = g.makeFlow(src, sink);
        if (fc.first != K) {
            throw new AssertionError();
        }
        System.out.println(fc.second);
        sc.close();
    }

    static void redirect(String[] args) {
        if (args.length > 0) {
            try {
                System.setIn(new FileInputStream(args[0]));
            } catch (FileNotFoundException e) {
                System.err.println("Failed to open '" + args[0] + "'");
                System.exit(1);
            }
        }
        if (args.length > 1) {
            try {
                System.setOut(new PrintStream(new FileOutputStream(args[1])));
            } catch (FileNotFoundException e) {
                System.err.println("Failed to open '" + args[1] + "'");
            }
        }
    }

    static class Pair<F, S> {
        public final F first;
        public final S second;

        public Pair(F f, S s) {
            this.first = f;
            this.second = s;
        }
    }

    static class MCMFEdge {
        int trg;
        int cap;
        int flow;
        long cost;
        long adjcost;
        int dual;

        MCMFEdge(int trg, long cost, int cap, int dual) {
            this.trg = trg;
            this.cost = cost;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = 0;
            this.adjcost = cost;
            this.dual = dual;
        }
    }

    static class MCMFGraph {
        List<List<MCMFEdge>> nodes;

        MCMFGraph(int size) {
            nodes = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                nodes.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
        }

        void add(int a, int b, long cost, int cap, int rcap) {
            if (a == b) return;
            if (cap > 0 && rcap > 0) {
                add(a, b, cost, cap, 0);
                add(b, a, cost, cap, 0);
            } else if (rcap > 0) {
                add(b, a, cost, rcap, 0);
            } else {
                int da = size(a);
                int db = size(b);
                nodes.get(a).add(new MCMFEdge(b, cost, cap, db));
                nodes.get(b).add(new MCMFEdge(a, -cost, 0, da));
            }
        }

        int size(int node) {
            return nodes.get(node).size();
        }

        Pair<Integer, Integer> makeFlow(int source, int sink) {
            for (List<MCMFEdge> edges : nodes) {
                for (MCMFEdge e : edges) {
                    e.flow = 0;
                    e.adjcost = e.cost;
                }
            }
            int totalFlow = 0;
            long totalCost = 0;
            while (true) {
                Pair<Integer, Long> up = augment(source, sink);
                int upFlow = up.first;
                if (upFlow == 0) break;
                totalFlow += upFlow;
                totalCost += up.second;
            }
            return new Pair<>(totalFlow, (int) totalCost);
        }

        Pair<Integer, Long> augment(int source, int sink) {
            int n = nodes.size();
            long big = Long.MAX_VALUE;
            long[] upby = new long[n];
            long[] prio = new long[n];
            int[] preve = new int[n];
            Arrays.fill(prio, big);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) prio[i] = big;
            prio[source] = 0;
            upby = new long[n];
            Arrays.fill(upby, big);
            upby[source] = big;

            PriorityQueue<PQItem> q = new PriorityQueue<>();
            q.add(new PQItem(source, 0));
            long[] dist = new long[n];
            Arrays.fill(dist, big);
            dist[source] = 0;

            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                PQItem curItem = q.poll();
                int cur = curItem.trg;
                long p = curItem.prio;

                if (p != prio[cur]) continue;
                List<MCMFEdge> edges = nodes.get(cur);
                for (int i = 0; i < edges.size(); i++) {
                    MCMFEdge e = edges.get(i);
                    if (e.flow < e.cap && e.adjcost >= 0) {
                        long p2 = p + e.adjcost;
                        int trg = e.trg;
                        if (p2 < prio[trg]) {
                            prio[trg] = p2;
                            preve[trg] = i;
                            upby[trg] = Math.min(e.cap - e.flow, upby[cur]);
                            q.add(new PQItem(trg, p2));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            long up = upby[sink];
            long upcost = 0;
            if (up > 0) {
                int cur = sink;
                while (cur != source) {
                    MCMFEdge ed = nodes.get(cur).get(preve[cur]);
                    MCMFEdge e = nodes.get(ed.trg).get(ed.dual);
                    e.flow += up;
                    upcost += e.cost * up;
                    ed.flow -= up;
                    cur = ed.trg;
                }
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    List<MCMFEdge> edges = nodes.get(i);
                    for (MCMFEdge e : edges) {
                        e.adjcost += prio[i] - prio[e.trg];
                    }
                }
            }
            return new Pair<>((int) up, upcost);
        }

        static class PQItem implements Comparable<PQItem> {
            int trg;
            long prio;

            PQItem(int trg, long prio) {
                this.trg = trg;
                this.prio = prio;
            }

            @Override
            public int compareTo(PQItem o) {
                return Long.compare(this.prio, o.prio);
            }
        }
    }
}
